name: Apache APISIX
description: API gateway that routes, authenticates, and rate-limits traffic to backend services.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/config:/usr/local/apisix/conf
  {{serviceName}}-etcd:
    image: bitnami/etcd:3.5
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-etcd
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      ALLOW_NONE_AUTHENTICATION: yes
      ETCD_LISTEN_CLIENT_URLS: "http://0.0.0.0:2379"
